datasets.name: Diverse Landslide Dataset (DLD)
datasets.verbatim: this study constructs a comprehensive landslide dataset, referred to as the Diverse Landslide Dataset (DLD), composed of three sub-datasets: the Southwest landslide dataset, the CAS landslide dataset, and the Taiwan landslide dataset.

datasets.name: Bijie dataset
datasets.verbatim: Ji, S., Yu, D., Shen, C., Li, W., Xu, Q.: Landslide detection from an open satellite imagery and digital elevation model dataset using attention boosted convolutional neural networks. Landslides. 17, 1337–1352 (2020)

datasets.name: Luding dataset
datasets.verbatim: Wang, H., Liu, J., Zeng, S., Xiao, K., Yang, D., Yao, G., Yang, R.: A novel landslide identification method for multi-scale and complex background region based on multi-model fusion: YOLO + U-Net. Landslides. 21, 901–917 (2024)

methods.name: Complex Terrain Landslide DEtection TRansformer (CTL-DETR)
methods.summary: CTL-DETR is a Transformer-based landslide detection model that integrates Synergistic Multi-Attention Feature Extraction (C2f-SMAG), Mixed Aggregation and Faster Fusion (MA-Fusion), and Context-Guided Downsampling (CG-Down) modules to enhance the accuracy and robustness of multi-morphological landslide feature recognition and complex terrain landslide detection.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes a Transformer-based landslide detection model, named Complex Terrain Landslide DEtection TRansformer (CTL-DETR)

availability.author_statement: "The data used to support the findings of this study is available from the corresponding author upon request."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked or made available, and the custom code for the CTL-DETR model lacks a repository or persistent link.
